text:
zoe.partnerops: Kicking off a Field Kit prep thread. Goal: ship a partners-facing test kit for Snowflake DeltaShare + Databricks notebooks + Qdrant adapter so partners can validate end-to-end in their environment. Target ship date: Thu Sep 2 09:00 PT. Reply with :white_check_mark: on items you own.

ben.engineering: I'll own the partner-facing test harness and sample dataset generation. Plan to generate a 10M vector sample (50k docs x 200 vectors) with varied column shapes (VARIANT, ARRAY, nested).

mia.docs: I'll own the kit docs, quickstarts, and the Databricks notebook examples. Need the ingest commands and the sample dataset S3 path.

raj.gtm: I'll handle the marketplace tile copy and partner outreach. Need brand approvals and a short partner checklist we can include in the kit.

isla.legal: Legal here  we'll need partner logo usage consent and a short indemnity note in the kit README. Send logos + approved wording by Tue EOD.

staging-bot: Created staging environment: partners-fieldkit-staging-2026-09-01 (owner: zoe.partnerops). Access: partner-testers SSO group.

ben.engineering: Sample dataset plan:
- 50k docs with mixed types (text, VARIANT metadata, nested tags)
- embeddings dim 384 and 768 variants
- export packages: DeltaShare manifest + sample Delta table + precomputed vectors as fallback
Artifact path: s3://redwood-fieldkit/fieldkit-10m-2026-09-01.tar.gz

mia.docs: Thanks Ben. For quickstart I'll need the exact CLI and a Databricks cell that installs the redwood wheel and runs a sample extract->embed->upsert flow. Drafting now.

ben.engineering: CLI snippet for the kit: ```
# one-off: push DeltaShare table to Qdrant
redwood ingest --connector fieldkit-deltashare \\
  --source delta://partner-test/db/schema/fieldkit_table \\
  --sink qdrant://partners-staging:6333 \\
  --shards 4 --quantize int8 --output /tmp/fieldkit-artifacts.tgz
```

mia.docs: Draft Databricks init cell for the notebook: ```
# cluster init: install redwood-client
%pip install redwood-client==2.4.0
```
And an example PySpark cell to SELECT and call embeddings API. I'll include a note about VARIANT flattening.

raj.gtm: For the marketplace tile, proposed one-liner: "Field Kit: a partner test kit for validating Snowflake DeltaShare -> Databricks -> Qdrant integrations." Benefit bullets: "prebuilt dataset, runbook, sample notebooks, and CI checks." Thoughts?

isla.legal: Also require a partner-facing license snippet in the README: short permissive terms + partner logos only for verification. I'll stub language and paste here.

ben.engineering: One compatibility note: current extractor drops deeply nested arrays. I'll add a normalize step in the harness and open PR. If that lands by Wed we'll include normalized sample Delta tables. PR link will be posted.

ci-bot: Fieldkit CI pipeline created (pipeline #6120) - will run integration tests against staging once artifacts are uploaded.

mia.docs: For the runbook I'll outline three flows: 1) Live serve via DeltaShare proxy, 2) Batch export to Qdrant, 3) Notebook-driven extract+upsert for Databricks. Each flow will have a checklist and expected perf numbers.

raj.gtm: Marketing asks: 2 screenshots (ingest dashboard + notebook preview), 1 short demo script for partner calls, and a partner-facing FAQ. Deadline for assets: Wed EOD to assemble kit Thursday.

ben.engineering: Perf estimates for kit guidance (staging numbers): 4 shards int8 ingest ~12k vec/s, query p95 ~38ms for 384-dim; for 768-dim reduce ingest to ~8k vec/s. Will include a small table in docs.

isla.legal: Pasted draft license snippet: "Field Kit is provided for partner validation only. Do not redistribute production copies of Redwood binaries or sample data outside your organization. Use of partner logos requires prior written consent." Please review.

mia.docs: Drafted README sections: overview, runbook, quickstarts, limitations, legal & logos, support contact. Linking to gist when ready.

ben.engineering: Opened PR #4987: fieldkit-normalize-step - adds deep array flatten and VARIANT helper. Tests included. Tagging @mia.docs for docs notes.

staging-bot: Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-fieldkit/fieldkit-10m-2026-09-01.tar.gz - sample Delta manifest + vectors + notebook gists attached.

raj.gtm: Partner outreach plan: send kit email to pilot partners Mon Sep 6, include staging access and a short checklist. I'll draft email and drop in thread for review.

isla.legal: Confirm logos received from Snowflake and Qdrant. Milvus still pending. Please hold any co-branded marketing until Milvus confirms.

mia.docs: Gist link: https://gist.github.com/redwood/fieldkit-notebooks (WIP) - includes Databricks notebooks and quickstart. Will finalize docs by Wed EOD.

ben.engineering: Perf dashboard screenshot uploaded to /assets/fieldkit/dash-384.png. Notebook preview screenshot uploaded to /assets/fieldkit/notebook-preview.png.

raj.gtm: Draft kit email posted to #marketing; asking for copy edit + legal review. Will wait for Milvus logo before sending to broader list.

isla.legal: Milvus legal confirmed logo ok with brand guidelines attached. Legal sign-off complete for kit.

zoe.partnerops: Recap + owners: ben.engineering (harness + data) :white_check_mark:, mia.docs (docs + notebooks) :white_check_mark:, raj.gtm (marketplace & outreach) :white_check_mark:, isla.legal (legal sign-off) :white_check_mark:. Target ship Thu Sep 2 09:00 PT - locking unless blockers.

ci-bot: Fieldkit CI run passed against staging - integration tests green.

zoe.partnerops: Thanks team. I'll publish the kit manifest and announce to pilot partners Mon Sep 6. This thread = canonical coordination log. Ping me if anything regresses. :rocket:
